# The review never reaches zero findings. The loop stops after the third review, and the first two reviews are each followed by a revise step and a check.
# The report is written under the name with -unreviewed and starts with the open findings of the last review.
# The item ends as stopped at the report step, so `beehave status` does not show it as a success. The last message of the reviewer is not a finding:
# the open findings come from the verdict file.
isolate

exec git init -q -b main origin
exec git -C origin add readme.txt
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m start

example research/workflow.star
example research/project.star config/projects/research.star
example research/prompts/scope.md
example research/prompts/research.md
example research/prompts/review.md
example research/prompts/revise.md
example research/prompts/conclude.md
example research/tools/check.sh
example research/tools/report.sh
fakeclaude
serve

env RESEARCH_TOOLS=$WORK/research/tools
env RESEARCH_OUT=$WORK/out

exec beehavereal item add research weigh-ab --title 'Compare A and B' --body-file body.txt

exitcode 1 beehavereal run weigh-ab research --workflow research/workflow.star
stdout 'item weigh-ab stopped at step command:report#[0-9]+ with exit code 3'
stdout 'The review left findings open'
stdout 'weigh-ab-unreviewed\.md'
! stdout 'finished'

exec beehavereal status
stdout 'weigh-ab-r1\tstopped\tstopped at command:report#[0-9]+ rc 3'

# Three reviews, two revise steps between them, no fourth review. The summary is written again after each revise step, so each review reads a summary of the notes it reviews.
cmp calls.log expected-calls.log

# The report is the unreviewed one, with the open findings of the last review on top, from the verdict file and not from the last message.
! exists out/weigh-ab.md
grep '^## Open findings$' out/weigh-ab-unreviewed.md
grep '^notes/1\.md: the source does not state the claim$' out/weigh-ab-unreviewed.md
! grep 'I reviewed the notes' out/weigh-ab-unreviewed.md
grep '^## Summary$' out/weigh-ab-unreviewed.md
grep '^## Sources$' out/weigh-ab-unreviewed.md

-- body.txt --
Compare A and B.
-- origin/readme.txt --
The source repository.
-- verdicts --
changes
changes
changes
-- expected-calls.log --
scope
research 1
research 2
summary
review
revise
summary
review
revise
summary
review
